title: Marshall Of The U. S. Court For China, Shanghai

page_data.en:
June 6, 41.

Marshall of the U.S. Court for China,
S H A N G H A I.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your letter
dated June 4, 1941, in regard to a working arrange-
ment between your office and this Force in regard to
the checking of Police records and in reply have to
state that there is no objection to the system you
outline except that I would suggest that the Assist-
ant Commissioner (Special Branch) Mr. V. Sharman or
his Personal Assistant Chief Inspector R.F. Tabrum be
the liaison officers to obtain any details which you
may require, as they normally deal with such matters.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

K.M. BOURNE
Commissioner of Police.

（批：CSC.）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SPECIAL BRANCH / JUN 6 1941）
page_data.zh:
1941年6月6日。

致驻华美国法院法警，
上 海。

先生：

谨此确认收到阁下1941年6月4日来信，关于贵处与本警务处在核查警察档案方面的工作安排事宜。现回复如下：除建议由助理总监（特别部）V. Sharman 先生或其私人助理、总督察 R.F. Tabrum 担任联络官以获取阁下可能需要的任何细节外，对阁下所概述的制度并无异议，因上述人员通常负责处理此类事务。

此致，
敬礼

K.M. BOURNE
警务处处长

page_data.en:
June 4, 1941.

Major K. M. Bourne,
Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir:

This office and the United States Consulate at
Shanghai obviously require confidential information from
time to time regarding the character and police records
of Americans and other nationals in connection with
various applications for administrative dispensations by
our Government, such as visas etc.

In order to obviate duplications of such reports
and to facilitate the handling of such matters on a routine
basis by your department my Chief Deputy as worked out a ten-
tative plan in collaboration with your Inspector J. C.
Dixon substantially as follows, to wit:

1. Our Consulate to supply our office with list of
names of individuals about whom police record
and character information is desired.

2. Our office to then submit the list to officer
in charge of Fingerprint Bureau with the re-
quest that the names be checked against your
police records, confidential files and refugee
files.

3. Your officer in charge of Fingerprint Bureau
to then report back to our office those names
on which there is no adverse information to-
gether with a brief summary of such police
record or adverse comments as may be pertinent
as to the others.

|| 4. Reports from your office should reach this
office, if possible, within 24 hours after such
names are submitted.

It is believed that the average number of names
that will be submitted will not exceed ten daily, however,
obviously this will be variable.

It is believed that some such plan as that above
outlined will save your department heads much inconvenience
which would otherwise be caused by having various officials
of the U.S. Consulate and our office telephoning direct
perhaps to a head of a department for information of this
kind which can be obtained on a routine basis.
page_data.zh:
1941年6月4日。

致 K. M. Bourne 少校，
处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

本处及驻上海美国领事馆显然需要不时获取有关美国人及其他国籍人士品行和警察档案的机密信息，以便处理我国政府各类行政特许申请（如签证等）相关事宜。

为避免此类报告重复，并便于贵部门按常规程序处理此类事务，我的首席副手与贵处 J. C. Dixon 巡官协作制定了一项暂定计划，大致内容如下：

1. 由我方领事馆向本处提供一份名单，列明需要查询其警察档案及品行信息的人员姓名。

2. 随后，本处将该名单提交给指纹局负责人，请求将名单上的姓名与贵处的警察档案、机密档案及难民档案进行核对。

3. 请贵处指纹局负责人随后向本处反馈那些没有不良记录的人员姓名，并简要汇总其他人员的有关警察档案记录或相关的不良评语。

4. 贵处的报告应在提交名单后24小时内（如可能）送达本处。

据信，提交的姓名平均每日不超过十个，但显然此数量会有波动。

相信上述概要的计划将为贵各部门主管省去诸多不便，否则，美国领事馆及本处的各位官员可能会直接致电某部门主管索取此类本可按常规程序获取的信息，从而造成困扰。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The reports which I will submit to the U.S.
Consulate will be based upon the information received
from your organization together with that which we have
obtained by separate investigations conducted by this
office. The sources of the information will not be
disclosed.

If you think well of the plan, will you be
good enough to advise me and have this office instructed
as to the exact routine procedure which would be found
most satisfactory to your organization.

Very truly yours,

Charles Richardson, Jr.,
Marshal of the United States Court
for China

CR:BJ
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

我将向美国领事馆提交的报告，将基于从贵机构收到的信息，以及本处通过独立调查获得的信息。信息来源将不予披露。

如阁下认为该计划可行，恳请告知，并指示本处了解对贵机构而言最为满意的具体常规程序。

此致，
敬礼

Charles Richardson, Jr.,
驻华美国法院法警
